exposure: operative birth (assisted vaginal or caesarean section)
outcome: Posttraumatic stress disorder (PTSD) symptoms after birth
finding: Avoidant attachment style, operative birth, and poor support during birth were all significantly correlated with postnatal PTSD symptoms, with women demonstrating avoidant attachment style who had operative deliveries being most at risk.
mod_finding: Women with avoidant attachment style who had operative deliveries were most at risk of PTSD symptoms.
